## What changed

Describe the problem and the smallest change that fixes it.

## Evidence

Include the host, model, original prompt, raw output, and expected behavior when the change affects review behavior.

## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `python scripts/check_repo.py`.
- [ ] I added or updated an evaluation case for behavior changes.
- [ ] I checked every affected platform adapter.
- [ ] I did not describe single-context lenses as independent evidence.
- [ ] I did not include private information in prompts or raw outputs.
